notes.title: New Update! New Gun, Upgraded AI, New Horror Coop, New Jetpack map, Jetpack options
notes.content:
- Revamped the AI. The AI now moves freely though the map, exploring, tracking down players, and completing objectives (like getting the flag or defending the flag carrier).

- AI has been added to a bunch of new maps (trackpad maps only).

- New Gun, the LMG! Has a large drum magazine, but is slow and inaccurate. Great for suppressive fire, or for people who hate reloading.

- New Jetpack Map, Factory! This map has a lot of verticality to it, and was made specifically for the jetpack.

- New Horror Coop level! Make your way around the factory, trying to locate the correct switches to return power to the teleporter.

- Jetpack maps now have the option between limited fuel and unlimited fuel (fly around without having to worry about gravity).

- Made a lot of changes to the map Canyon to make it more limited fuel jetpack friendly.

I hope you all enjoy the update!! Let me know what you think or if you find any bugs!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
- Upgraded the map "'Face Off". There was something off about it, so I made some changes. It is now called "Fort".

-  Added a "disable teleport" button on the watch because people kept accidentally teleporting when using the trackpad.

- The jetpack map (regular gravity one) now starts you with the jetpack. It is now controlled by clicking the left trackpad.

- Made the horror co-op a little easier.

- (On maps with scattered weapons) If you die with a starting weapon, they no longer auto change to the pistol.

- Color rifle has been buffed, and color blobs do more damage.

- Balanced some weapons. The most notable buffs are the grenade launcher and the laser carbine.

- Fixed a LOT of bugs. Let me know if you find any more!

- New Demo!!! You can now play any map (except co-op maps), but you can only use the pistol!!

Have fun and let me know what you think!

notes.title: New update: 2 new levels, new co-op mode, polish
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! This update includes:

- New co-op mode: Swarm 2. This time you are surrounded by the enemies, and you can roam freely around the level. You also have the option of turning the lights off to make it more intense.

- 2 new levels: Face Off and Complex. Face Off is a straight forward head on level. Complex has 3 floors, some hallways, and a 3 story tower in the middle.

- I added noises to a lot of things (bullets impacts, explosions, shooting color, tile color changes, core hits).

- Enemies heads will now explode when killed with a head shot.

- New cores. They now look small stars, and they go *whoom* when you hit them.

- You can now toggle two handed aiming with the grip button.

- Increased bullet speeds for higher powered rifles.

- Added a little colored orb to the color guns to make it more obvious that they are color guns.

- Bug fixes.

Let me know if you find any bugs! Have fun!

notes.title: New Update: Horror Coop + some additions/fixes/changes
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! I've always wanted to make a scary experience in VR, so I figured I would make it in Battle Dome so you have another co-op experience to play.

Today's update includes:

- Horror Escape! Play with up to 4 people or alone. You are in a dark facility where biological experiments are held. All you have is your pistol with a flashlight attachment. Try to escape before getting eaten alive!

- New enemy in the co-op mode (Swarm). Alien canine-like creature; weak but moves fast.

- The players now have hands. You will also unlock bronze, silver, and gold glove skins when you get enough kills.

- The watch has been given extra functionality. Almost all options are now on your watch rather than on the walls.

- There is now a left handed option (on your watch).

- You can now select the number of players you would like in a new game.

- Heist mode has been changed to You Only Live Once. You have one life per round, first team to 7 wins. Dying puts you into spectator mode where you can scale the level. This mode has been expanded to include all maps.

- Your movement speed is now slowed when you crouch or lay down.

- The mute function is fixed.

- Lot's of bug fixes and tweaks.

I hope you all enjoy the update!! Some screenshots can be found on the Steam page. I wanted to include a video, but I ran out of time. I'll try to replace the extremely outdated video as soon as I can.

Also, let me know if there are any bugs!

notes.title: New Update, Co-op!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! I just released a new update today.

It includes:

- New co-op mode. Fight off waves of 6 different types of enemies, alone or with a friend.

- The laser sword now reflects bullets correctly (bullets will no longer clip through it).

- There are now voice chat options on your left wrist. You can select All, Team, or Mute. The push to talk seemed to confuse most people.

- There are now a few quick select options for starting a quick match.

- Various bug fixes, tweaks, and optimizations.

There are a few screenshots of the co-op mode on the store page. I'll try to get a video up as well, I just need to record some footage.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/484870

Let me know what you think /  if you find any bugs. The next update will most likely include another (but a little different) co-op mode.

notes.title: New Update! Polish, new weapons, new level, leadersboard, and skins
notes.content:
New Update!!

- Replaced the plasma projectiles

- Replaced the Rocket Launcher model

- Replaced the rocket projectiles, and added splash damage

- Added trails to bullets and plasma

- Replaced the muzzle flash for guns, and also added a lighting effect

- Added a new bullet collision effect.

- Replaced the shield model

- New weapon: plasma pistol. 

- New weapon: Grenade launcher. The grenade launcher is more of a support gun. It should small plasma grenades, as well as smoke, paint, time dilation field (slows incoming projectiles, speeds up outgoing), and explosive. Press either up, left, right, or down on the touchpad to fire the special grenades.

- New weapon: small assault rifle. Slow rate of fire and damage, but very low recoil, plus holographic sight.

- New color map: Warehouse. Mostly very close quarters, but open in the center.

- New stat tracking and leader board system.

- Weapon skins. You can unlock bronze, silver, and gold skins for each weapon by racking up kills.

- You can now see your health on your wristwatch on every map.

- Added support for the Hardlight suit (a haptic suit).  Here is a link to their kickstarter page.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/morgansinko/hardlight-vr-suit-dont-just-play-the-game-feel-it


The next big update will be a complete replacement for the horrible coop mode.

I hope you all enjoy this update! Let me know if you find any bugs.

Also, it would be nice if we all had a weekly playtime. If you are interested, let me know what day / time would be best for you.


**EDIT**

ALSO, I will be on from about 8 - 10 EST if anyone would like to test the new update tonight!

**DOUBLE EDIT**

Also forgot,

- Replaced the Sniper Rifle skin

- Made it so the sniper now acts as a regular laser weapon (no charge) since almost everyone hated it. It has a small mag, but is powerful

Also, there are some pics of the grenade launcher (with time dilation field and smoke), plasma pistol, shield, weapon skins, new level, and rocket launcher on the store page. Sorry I didn't have time to make a GIF :( 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/484870

notes.title: New Update: Demo, Jetpack, free M/KB link
notes.content:
I made a demo so people who don't own the game can try it. In the demo, you can only play on the map "Control". You can play with people who own the game.

In this update, I also included a new map called "Grand Control". It is a different, bigger version on the map "Control", which is how I originally intended it. In this map, you can pick up a jetpack. I wanted to see how a regular, non- antigravity map would play when there are jetpacks involved. Since this isn't an antigravity level like the other jetpack level, the jetpacks will only boost you up for a few seconds before it needs to be recharged.

The new jetpack is currently activated by pressing on the right trackpad, with a fuel gauge floating in front of your right gun.

Also, here is a link to the FREE M/KB version of Battle Dome. Give it to your lame non-VR friends. After the next update, they will have to download the new updated one, though.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B2TKax-BR5oyanI2TUlPRlpyTXc?usp=sharing

Let me know if there are any bugs, and what you think of the jetpack in the new level.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone. Sorry this update took a while, there have been a few technical difficulties along the way. Also, there were a few things I wanted to put in for this update, but I ran out of time and I want to get this out today.

- Duel wield one handed weapons!

- New gun: Semi-auto sniper rifle. 

- New TDM map. This one is a little different. Instead of all weapons being available in spawn, they are dispersed around the map. I'd like to eventually open this (and all) maps up to be able to be played with any game mode. I'll add that in a future update.

- You can now play with mouse / keyboard. I made this because I've always wanted to play my game with my friends and family, none of whom have a VR headset. Maybe some of you feel the same way as me, and now you can play with your non-VR friends. Press the SPACE bar to activate M/KB mode.

- You can now pick up guns with any hand (the empty hand model still needs to be flipped for the right hand, sorry lefties). Use the application button on the left controller to pickup with that hand just as you would do with your right.

- I redid the physics/clipping system. The anti-clip system is now much smoother when you walk into a wall. A little more work needs to be done for trackpad, though. Also, there is now gravity and fall damage (instead of just teleporting down when you walk off a ledge).

- Trackpad movement can now be used in KotH 2 (Anti-grav map).

- Trackpad movement speed has increased.

- Bullet speed has increased.

- Instead of color maps being split by teleport distance limit, they are now all grouped together, and you can select whether you want limited/unlimited teleport distance as an option.

- Reload is now the grip buttons

- There is now a maximum distance when you want to select something (so you can no longer change your guns all the way across the map). Your selector beam will change from red to green when you are close enough).

- Fixed a few bugs, including the broken sword/spear bug.

Have fun and let me know if you find any bugs!

notes.title: New Update! Plasma Weapons
notes.content:
Hi, everybody!

Today's update includes:

- Plasma weapons - A new class of weapons. They fire based on heat rather than ammo. Also, their bullets are slower moving, slightly less recoil, and more powerful than their regular bullet firing counterparts when hitting the body (headshot damage is still the same).

- New gun - Plasma Rifle

- New gun - Plasma SMG

- The Sonic Resonator now has a laser sight that will estimate the bullets trajectory. This is a little iffy at the moment because for some reason certain surfaces are bouncing the bullet kinda weird. I'll have to try to make this more consistent. Also, you can turn it off by clicking the trackpad.

- Regular bullets now fly much faster (about 60-70% faster depending on the bullet).

- Trackpad locomotion is now available in TDM.

- Trackpad locomotion has been tweaked to be faster.

- Tweaked TDM map and Jetpack map.

Let me know how it goes! Have fun!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Hellooooo everybody!

Today's update includes:

- Redid the recoil system! So many of you have complained, so i rewrote the recoil. It no longer keeps going up and up. The gun is now still fixed into the correct angle, and bullets will spread in an upwards cone the longer you fire your weapon.

- New Weapon - Sonic Resonator. This is an experimental gun, it might suck, it might not. You tell me. Basically, the bullets bounce off of walls, gaining power with each bounce (breaks on the 4th bounce).

- New Weapon - Laser Spear. While I was at Dev Days, I ran into a Battle Dome veteran /u/puzzabug. We were hanging out, and we ran into a few of the guys from Stress Level Zero (Hover Junkers). Puzzabug (i hope) jokingly suggested that they add spears to Hover Junkers. The idea cracked me up, and I figured, why not add it to BD and so we can do some jetpack jousting!

- Jetpack smoke trail and noise for the new jetpack map

- The jetpack map is now anti-grav, so you can teleport to any surface. Turn the roof into the floor. Go nuts.

- Bug fixes and tweaks.



I hope you all enjoy the new stuff / changes!

Also, I'd like to test 5 v 5 and see how it runs. If you see a game by Dr. Gooseman with up to 10 players, join!

notes.title: New Update! Experimental mode
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

So I've been working hard to get a beta version of this next map out before I head to Seattle for the week. This new map is CTF, but with a little twist. If you look on your left wrist, you now have the option to enable your jetpack! When you land by teleporting, or die, the jetpack will toggle back off again and you can walk around as per usual.

This map is very new, and there is still a lot that needs to be done with the jetpack and the level. I had to program the anti-clip to work with the jetpack, and it still needs a lot of tweaking, so try not to abuse any bugs until I can polish it up a bit.

Also, I didn't get a chance to add a jetpack sound, I'm really running out of time and I need to pack. I just wanted to get the beta version out so you can all try it and tell me what you think.

Also, I will probably increase the speed of the bullets. The large size of this map really accents the current slow bullet speed.

Let me know what you think!

Let me know what you think!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody. I decided to push the beta version of the new mode I'm working on to the main build.

- New mode in progress! It's a round based mode (kind of like Counter Strike). One round, one life. Eliminate the enemy team to win a round. First to 7 wins. Also, if you are red team, you can steal the contents of the safe and retreat to your spawn to win. There is a number pad that you put the code in (right now its just 1234), and it opens the locker with the flag in it (it will eventually be space cash or something). (This mode is still very much in progress, so there may be some bugs).

- Trackpad motion! This is only enabled in the new mode right now for testing. You can enable it by selecting it on your left wrist (there is a little screen now on your wrist. If you select it with the menu button, it will toggle trackpad motion on).

- You now enter a special spectator mode when you die in the new mode. You can move around and scale the map with your hands, like a tiny little space doll house. (I haven't tested this with other players yet, but hopefully it works).

- Lowered some of the recoil a bit since many of you have complained about it. I just lowered it a little, so I may have to lower it again if that still isn't enough. The recoil system is very new, and needs a lot of tweaking and polishing.

- Fixed a lot of small bugs.

**EDIT**

Here are some screenshots of the spectator mode. Much cooler to watch in person though.

http://imgur.com/a/xdENM

notes.title: New Update! Big gun changes!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody! There are some big changes this week.

- All ballistic guns now have recoil! Burst fire is recommended.

- Most of the guns have had their damages tweaked. Most guns are a bit deadlier.

- Most guns have had their skins and sounds changed.

- 3 new weapons! A new pistol, smg, and assault rifle.

- Capture the flag mode! I haven't been able to do much testing yet, so let me know if there are any bugs.

- There is now a max teleport distance in ALL maps. I'm hoping that this will make the game a bit more tactical with movement, and encourage more cover based fire fights rather than just spamming long distance teleports. Also, this is a step towards the addition of track pad locomotion.

- Improved the performance in Map 1 DTC. Let me know if you notice an improvement.

- There is now a sound that plays when you get a head shot. I'd like to change this sound soon, but it's the best sound I've found so far.

- Fixed some small bugs.

I hope you all like the new update and direction of the game! Happy battling!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
- New lobby! Just aesthetic for now, but I'd like to add some things to do while you wait for players. I hope you like space beer!

- The lobby now lists ALL available matches (you don't need to select a game type to see matches).

- Tweaked DTC Map 1. I plan on redoing Map 1 soon, so I wanted to change and test the way the balconies and ramps are to see if it would be better this way. Let me know if you like the new way, or the old way.

- New laser pistol! It works a little differently. The pistol has a short cool down after each shot, but doesn't need to be reloaded.

- Tweaked KotH Map 2. I made it easier to know which side is which by placing some colors/markers on the walls. I also moved and resized a few objects to close some of the really quick/easy ways to get into the kill, while opening a few new ways.

- Made the laser rifle a little more accurate.

- Added volume bars for SFX and Voice, and put the volume bars in each level. I also lowered the default music and SFX volumes a little. I am also considering lowering the SFX/music volume when people talk. Let me know what you think of this, or if the volume bars are enough.

- You are now told the name of whom you killed / who killed you.

- Fixed the bug that prevented elevated tiles and ramps from syncing when you join a new game (many of you thought people were cheating, but in reality it was just a sync bug).

- Slightly nerfed the shield (shrinks a little faster / takes longer to start recharging).

- Fixed the bug that caused team chat to only work half the time. Now team chat works, so use it!! (right hand grips)

Let me know if you find any bugs/issues. Thanks for playing Battle Dome, have fun!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
- New King of the Hill map! It's a no-paint, anti-gravity map. You can teleport onto any side of a surface!

- New weapon! The laser rifle.

- Changed the sound and beam color of the laser carbine

- New bodies! Say goodbye to the blob bodies (for now, at least). I may add it back in as a novelty skin if people want it.

- Team switch button! You can only switch if your team has more players than the other.

- The bodies now lay backwards if you lay on the floor (it still needs to adjusting, but its good enough for now).

- Changed the spawn locations on the Team Deathmatch level.

- Adjusted the pushback anti-clip system so make accidental deaths much more unlikely (though there is still a chance that it will happen if you teleport directly into a corner).

- You can no longer kill each other in the lobby of a match (save it for the match, you animals!)

- Made the sniper scope 50% bigger.

- Match stats don't reset until the next match begins (so you can look at your stats in the lobby after the match).

Thanks for the patience, everyone. New updates should come quicker now that I started working on Battle Dome full time. Let me know if there are any bugs.

Have fun!
